services.title: What I bring to your organization
services.intro: Services tailored to nonprofits and SMBs: pragmatic, documented, jargon-free. You don't need a full-time IT director — you need a trusted technical partner.

items.title: Security audit
items.description: Analysis of your infrastructure: identification of vulnerabilities, misconfigurations and improvement areas. Clear report with prioritized recommendations.

items.title: Systems administration
items.description: Management of your Linux/Windows servers, routers and firewalls. Monitoring with Zabbix, updates and rapid response.

items.title: Infrastructure hardening
items.description: System hardening, network segmentation, access and password management. Solid foundations to reduce your exposure.

items.title: Virtualization
items.description: Deployment and administration of your on-premise virtualized environments (Proxmox, VMware). Containerization with Docker.

items.title: Business continuity
items.description: Backup strategy, documented recovery procedures and regular testing. So your activity survives any incident.

items.title: Support & guidance
items.description: Single technical contact for organizations without an IT department. Regular follow-up, incident response, documentation and team coaching.

creationWeb.title: Your online presence, hassle-free
creationWeb.intro: Modern, fast and accessible websites — built for nonprofits and SMBs that want a professional showcase without agency costs or delays.

items.title: Landing page
items.description: A professional one-page or multi-section website. Responsive design, fast loading, contact form. Turnkey delivery.

items.title: Multi-page site
items.description: Structured site of 3 to 5 pages, no CMS. Ideal for organizations with stable content: about, team, contact.

items.title: Design & branding
items.description: Brand guidelines, mockups and implementation. A site that reflects you, consistent with your communication.

items.title: SEO & performance
items.description: Natural search and performance optimization: Core Web Vitals, tags, sitemap. To be found on Google.

items.title: Redesign
items.description: Modernization of an existing site: new design, technical migration, improved performance and accessibility.

items.title: Maintenance
items.description: Regular updates, automatic backups, availability monitoring and rapid fixes. Your site in good hands.

pricing.title: Clear packages
pricing.intro: No surprises. The packages below cover the most common needs. Free quote for any specific project.

tiers.name: Landing page

methodology.title: How I work
methodology.intro: A structured four-phase approach, adapted to your organization's operational reality.
methodology.callout: Operational security is not a final state — it's an ongoing process of adapting to threats and to the evolution of your organization.

steps.title: Risk analysis
steps.description: Mapping of the IT system, identification of critical assets and attack vectors. Risk report prioritized to your business.

steps.title: Hardening
steps.description: OS hardening, network segmentation, privilege management, encryption and update policy per CIS benchmarks.

steps.title: Continuous monitoring
steps.description: Deployment of monitoring and anomaly detection tools. Dashboards, alerts and periodic log review.

steps.title: Incident response
steps.description: Documented procedures for every type of incident: ransomware, intrusion, outage. Regular testing and continuous improvement.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: Personal data collected on opsec-it.fr is processed by Sylvestre MIGNOT, site publisher, acting as data controller within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

data.title: Data collected
data.intro: Only data strictly necessary to process your request is collected via the contact form:
items: Subject and content of the message
data.note: No sensitive data within the meaning of article 9 of the GDPR is collected. No tracking cookies, no third-party analytics tools are deployed on the site.

purpose.title: Purposes and legal basis
purpose.intro: Data is collected and processed to:
items: establish, where applicable, a commercial proposal;
ensure follow-up of the contractual relationship if it materializes.
purpose.note: The legal basis is your consent (article 6.1.a of the GDPR), given by voluntarily submitting the form, as well as the performance of pre-contractual measures at your request (article 6.1.b).

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.p1: Data is intended exclusively for Sylvestre MIGNOT. It is neither sold, rented nor transferred to third parties.
recipients.p2: Contact emails are sent via the Resend service (resend.com) acting as a sub-processor within the meaning of the GDPR.

retention.title: Retention period
items: Requests without commercial follow-up: 12 months maximum
Requests resulting in a commercial relationship: duration of the relationship + 3 years (prospecting), 10 years (accounting obligations)

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: In accordance with articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: right of access to your data;
right to withdraw your consent at any time.
rights.cnil: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: This site uses no tracking or audience measurement cookies. Only strictly necessary technical cookies may be deposited (if applicable, none to date).

security.title: Security
security.body: Collected data is transmitted via HTTPS and stored securely. Given the nature of the activity, proportionate technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect your data against unauthorized access.
